prompt: 之前搜索过一次positon-mkdv，现在在此基础上进一步扩大范围搜索变系数的mkdv，不要高维和复数的

assertions.name: multi_round_search_plan
assertions.description: Shows search plan with ≥3 rounds and ≥40 paper target before searching

assertions.name: download_retry_mechanism
assertions.description: When download fails (non-PDF or truncated), shows retry across multiple channels before giving up

assertions.name: core_paper_failure_notification
assertions.description: When core paper download fails, pauses and requests user help with formatted template

assertions.name: four_element_summary
assertions.description: Per-paper summaries include equation form, core method, main results, and special contribution

assertions.name: search_round_logging
assertions.description: README head notes search round info like '搜索轮次：3（第一轮N篇+第二轮+M篇+第三轮+K篇）'

assertions.name: paper_count_≥18
assertions.description: Finds at least 18 papers on vc-mKdV (previous search found 18)
